Does anyone one have anything to share that might be helpful for me? I am looking for possible entertaining youtube channels, not necessarily educational ones, but ones that will immerse me into their everyday language shtick. I am quite familiar with speaking spanish, I have just been out of loop with it recently. I am in the process of teaching myself dutch
looking for videos to help me learn (Dutch and Espanol)

Español: For instructional videos, I like to Use SenorJordan. All of his video are short and sweet and grammar focused, and he uses stories to help teach concepts, so he's very good for beginner/intermediate learners of the language. As far as listening comprehension goes, I recommend Easy Languages, they have a large collection of episodes where they go out on the streets and talk to natives about certain topics (Economy, Jobs, Tourism, Life, etc). And while it's sort of cliché, most of my entertainment comes from HolaSoyGerman, though I do find at he speaks so quickly that I have to pause and repeat to get the gist of what he's saying.

Nederlands: I've only just started teaching myself Dutch, so I'm a little more limited in this area. For instruction purposes, I haven't really been watching any videos on youtube, but I have been using the podcast LauraSpeaksDutch which provides good lessons on vocabulary and culture, though it doesn't really hit on grammar. Easy Languages also have some videos on Dutch, but they're very rudimentary and contain material you could probably learn within 10 minutes of being on Duolingo. For listening/entertainment, I mainly watch 2 nederlandse youtubers, EnzoKnol and Ericos. Both are in their 20s and are really good examples of the Dutch-English mixture the younger generation is speaking.
